text:
maya: Nightly eval flagged a spike in "attribution/fabricated-source" failures on the legal-suffix prompt set for LlamaX-3b-v2 int6.
ci-bot: nightly-eval: model=LlamaX-3b-v2|variant=int6-perch|eval=legal-suffix|fail_rate=7.2%|baseline_fp16=0.4%
cheng: which prompts show it? any pattern?
maya: concentrated on prompts that end with "Please cite sources." — short context then long explicit suffix.
samir: is this hallucination or citation formatting bug? example?
maya: here's one (trimmed):
```
Q: Summarize the precedent for implied warranty in landlord-tenant law. Please cite sources.
A: The implied warranty of habitability is governed by Smith v. Hanover, 32 F.3d 123 (1999); see also the Rest.2d §45. For more, consult State v. Remington, 77 A.2d 999 (2001).
```
maya: both case names and citations are completely fabricated.
olivia: weird — FP16 baseline report had fail_rate=0.4% and different error modes, right?
maya: correct. FP16 no fabricated citations on same prompts. regression after quantize->int6.
cheng: can you repro locally? try running with --no-kv-cache and raw tokens to rule out kv alignment bug.
maya: ran quick local: same fabricated cases even with --no-kv-cache :(
samir: try loading FP16 weights into the same runtime (no quant) but keep other runtime bits same — isolates if quant step or runtime kernel.
olivia: also check tokenizer offsets for suffix concatenation. padding/truncation could be shoving suffix tokens into prompt boundary and confusing model.
maya: added small reproducer gist in thread, will run cherrypick tests. plan: 1) reproduce deterministically 2) bisect quant step 3) run FP16 in same runtime 4) add failing prompts to nightly-alerts and eval-triage.
cheng: ack, I'll start with 1+2. ping me in thread when you have the exact prompt ids.
maya: @cheng prompt ids: 2234,2235,2236. running bisect now. :eyes:
olivia: I'll open an eval-ticket and link this thread. assigning to @cheng and @olivia. set priority=P1
samir: if bisect points to quant packer, we may need emergency rollback for int6 variant from hosted pool.
maya: noted — will coordinate with infra if bisect confirms. thanks all.
ci-bot: alert posted to #incidents for oncall awareness.
